name: large-giant-orchestration-bug-detector
description: Detects cross-module API contract mismatches and orchestration bugs in giant monorepos using hierarchical discovery.

preToolUse.instruction: Intercept attempts to recursively search or read large directories/files. Rewrite the tool call to use 'generate_module_map' or 'extract_contract_graph' instead to preserve context and follow the 4-Phase Protocol.
